summary: Group of chips for labels, selectable filters, or removable values, keyboard-navigable like a grid.
whenNotToUse: A single, non-interactive status: use Badge.

props.name: label / description / errorMessage
props.description: Group label and linked text (otherwise aria-label).

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Enables the remove button and the Delete/Backspace keys.

props.name: renderEmptyState
props.description: Content shown when there are no tags.

props.name: Tag: icon / textValue / isDisabled
props.description: Leading icon, accessible text, disabled state.

inherits: Props of react-aria-components TagGroup and Tag.

keyboard.action: Enters the group (a single tab stop).

accessibility: role="grid": each tag is a row; the remove button has a localized name (“Remove …”).
Selected tags show a checkmark in addition to color.
responsive: Tags wrap; long text is visually truncated, while the accessible name contains the full text.
customization: data-selected, data-size, and the --dc-color-* tokens for colors.
commonMistakes: Using Tag for informational statuses: Badge is lighter.
